chapters.label: The last minute, live
chapters.text: World Cup 2022: Portugal against Uruguay, the last minute. The referee checks the screen. Penalty! Bruno Fernandes: slow steps... a little hop... and he rolls it in. Goal!

chapters.label: Watch the hop
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Small, slow steps. Then the hop: his eyes stay on the keeper. Rochet moves first... so Bruno rolls it the other way.

chapters.label: The wrong way
chapters.text: From the goal line: the keeper dives one way, the ball goes the other! Portugal win two-nil.

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Watch the keeper as you run up. Wait for him to move... then put it the other way!
